Standardise CVR numbers

Source: R/clean_cvr.R
clean_cvr.Rd

Cleans a vector of Danish CVR numbers to the canonical 8-digit form: dashes and spaces are stripped ("12 34 56 78" -> "12345678"), and a leading "DK" VAT prefix is removed ("DK12345678" -> "12345678"). This is the form cvr_query() requires, so CVR numbers from a spreadsheet or another register go through clean_cvr() first.

Usage

clean_cvr(x)

Arguments

x

A character vector of CVR numbers. Numeric vectors are converted with as.character() first.

Value

A character vector of the same length.

Details

Seven-digit values are not zero-padded: a lost leading zero cannot be distinguished from a typo, and inventing a digit would let a malformed number slip past the 8-digit check in cvr_query(). Values are returned cleaned but otherwise untouched, so malformed numbers stay visibly malformed. This differs from clean_cpr() in the pnrr package, which does pad CPR numbers: birth days 01-09 make that padding unambiguous.

clean_cvr() started in the daos package and moved here unchanged, next to the functions that use CVR numbers.

See also

cvr_query()

Other cvr: cvr_download(), cvr_hits(), cvr_query(), cvr_search()

Examples

clean_cvr(c("DK12345678", "12 34 56 78", "12345678", NA))
#> [1] "12345678" "12345678" "12345678" NA        

# Typical use: clean, then query
# cvr_query(clean_cvr(firms$cvr), "2024-01-01", "2024-12-31")
